description: Frontend + admin-join flow + static layout/text changes that depend on FEAT-001's RPC and is_admin column. Covers: (a) add is_admin to the Player type and admin param to joinRoom + a listActiveRooms wrapper in gameActions; (b) kamus-admin 'Lihat Lobi Aktif' view listing rooms with status Menunggu/Bermain/Selesai and a Join-as-admin action for 'Menunggu' rooms; (c) admin joins as 'Admin-SSK' with robot avatar via saveIdentity + existing device id, routed to /room/[code]; (d) hide the kick button for admin players in the lobby; (e) expand AVATARS to >=16 unique face/animal emojis with robot reserved for admin (not player-selectable) and show ALL avatars in the home picker; (f) move the play-screen turn/timer/input panel to the TOP, players + word chain below; (g) remove the '- sudah 2 kali gagal.' text in RelaxNotice. Depends on FEAT-001 (join_room p_is_admin, list_active_rooms, is_admin). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: src/types/game.ts: add `is_admin: boolean;` to the Player interface (place near is_host).

src/lib/gameActions.ts: update joinRoom to accept an optional `isAdmin = false` and pass `p_is_admin: isAdmin` to the join_room rpc. Add a `listActiveRooms(pin: string)` wrapper calling supabase.rpc('list_active_rooms', { p_pin: pin }) returning an array of { code, status, player_count, created_at }; export a matching `ActiveRoom` interface. Follow the existing thin-wrapper + listSuggestions error-propagation style.

src/lib/session.ts: expand AVATARS to at least 16 UNIQUE emojis (keep existing ones, add new distinct face/animal emojis to reach >=16; do NOT add a duplicate). Add a separate exported constant `ADMIN_AVATAR = "\uD83E\uDD16"` (robot) and keep it OUT of the AVATARS array so normal players never get the robot; ensure randomAvatar never returns the robot (it only picks from AVATARS, which is correct as long as robot is excluded).
src/app/page.tsx: change the avatar picker to render ALL avatars (replace `AVATARS.slice(0, 10)` with `AVATARS`); keep the flex-wrap layout so it stays tidy on mobile.

src/app/kamus-admin/page.tsx: after PIN unlock, add a 'Lihat Lobi Aktif' button that calls listActiveRooms(pin) and shows a list of rooms. Render each room's code, player_count, created_at, and a status badge mapped: lobby->'Menunggu', playing->'Bermain', finished->'Selesai' (use existing Tailwind tokens; green/accent for Menunggu, amber/accent for Bermain, muted for Selesai). For rooms with status lobby ('Menunggu'), show an 'Ikut Bermain' button. Clicking it: build the device id via getDeviceId(), call joinRoom(code, 'Admin-SSK', ADMIN_AVATAR, true), saveIdentity(code, { playerId, name: 'Admin-SSK', avatar: ADMIN_AVATAR }), then router.push(`/room/${code}`). Handle BAD_PIN/errors consistent with existing handlers. Keep the existing suggestion-review UI intact; this is an additional view (e.g. a toggle or a second section), not a replacement.

src/components/PlayerChip.tsx: hide the kick button when the target is an admin. Change the kick-button guard from `onKick && !player.is_host` to also exclude admins: `onKick && !player.is_host && !player.is_admin`. (Lobby already passes onKick only for non-self; this adds admin protection in the UI to match the server CANT_KICK_ADMIN.)

src/app/room/[code]/play/page.tsx: reorder the JSX so the main turn panel (the 'Sambung dari' / TimerRing / 'Giliran:' section) AND the input section render at the TOP of the main column (right after the small Room/header row), and the 'Rantai kata' (WordChain) section and the 'Daftar pemain' grid render BELOW them. Keep the countdown/relax overlays and header where they are. Preserve all existing props, handlers, and the `mt-auto` only where it still makes visual sense (players list can keep mt-auto to sit at the bottom). Keep it tidy on mobile (max-w-md column).
src/components/RelaxNotice.tsx: remove the clause '- sudah 2 kali gagal.' from the paragraph so it reads naturally, e.g. 'Suku kata -<full> terlalu sulit.' Keep the rest of the copy and layout.
acceptance_criteria: Player type has is_admin; joinRoom passes p_is_admin; gameActions exports listActiveRooms + ActiveRoom.
kamus-admin shows an active-lobbies list with Menunggu/Bermain/Selesai badges and an 'Ikut Bermain' action for lobby rooms that joins as Admin-SSK with the robot avatar and routes to /room/[code].
AVATARS has >=16 unique emojis with no robot inside it; ADMIN_AVATAR robot is exported separately; home page renders all AVATARS.
PlayerChip does not render the kick button for admin players.
On the play screen the turn/timer/input panel appears above the word chain and player list.
RelaxNotice no longer contains 'sudah 2 kali gagal'.
`npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` exits 0 and `npx next build` exits 0.
